provenance.method: Review each bounded proposal against morphology, current canonical and surface coverage, source-bound paragraph identifiers, and local contexts. Admit only a resolved in-scope lexical identity, POS, and one bounded Typewriter-authored meaning; hold evidenced identity, POS, sense, or collision uncertainty. Analyzer counts and writer usefulness do not determine lexical eligibility.

index.sample_policy: one paragraph when paragraph ordinal modulo 20 is zero, within each source-ordered document

selection.selection_rationale: The deterministic corpus-evidence order sets a bounded review queue only; each disposition follows separate lexical identity, POS, sense, and current surface coverage review.

extraction_error_classes: one-best morphology can misclassify unknown or context-ambiguous forms
compound segmentation can surface morphemes that still need lexical-boundary review
